venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 9/29 (MOD MKZ/jk; 82/55).** Net sales $747 vs target $2,115 (-64.7%). Food $123. Comps $75.70. 31 guests, check avg $24.11. Quieter bingo Tuesday than usual; Braves game may have pulled people to the stadium or sports bars. A stage came in at 4pm and saw the flow of service; a few regulars and a couple new faces. Barback handled prep for the week; Trivia and football mentioned to guests. Night ended smoothly. Kitchen: smooth. 86: dusse. No incidents. Favorite moment: a first-time guest enjoying themselves.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 9/29 (MOD/Chef MD / JMS; warm and clear).** Net sales $1,280 vs target $1,296 (-1.2%). Food $96. Comps $36.70 (2.9%; manager comp, industry, bingo credits, resident). 40 guests, check avg $32.00. Sleepier Tuesday; about $300 in sales at 7pm, picked up ~8pm and stayed steady past close with no pops. 10:30pm reservation cancelled. Kitchen: JMS held it down and was present on the floor. Maintenance: well 1 soda tap handle. Favorite moment: returning guests in the last hour who said they'd be back tomorrow.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 9/29 (AM MOD Maggie S; PM MOD Maggie H).** Total net sales incl. events $12,394.07 vs target $7,925 (+56.4%). Food incl. events $4,976.75; net event sales $3,054 (event food $2,160). Regular net $9,340.07 (DC/AM $1,053.57; D&C PM $8,286.50). Comps $415.05. 206 guests (Tock), check avg $60.16 (net/guests). AM: smooth and steady, calmed in final hours for deep cleaning; lots of coffee compliments; low oat milk and coconut milk; 86 caramel. PM: lots of hotel guests; team reminded to look after themselves amid sickness going around. Events: two events (Vauxhall and Suite 6A, 8am-5pm) — NACT group debriefed after 10am; Lauterbach group full day of meetings; breakfast, lunch and afternoon spreads went smoothly. Kitchen: chill, busier at close; 911 wagyu for tartare; several prep items low.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 9/29 (MOD Kyler; subtle fall).** Net sales $4,410 vs target $3,700 (+19.2%). Beverage $4,370; retail $40; food $0 (no kitchen). Comps $96.94 (2.2%). 140 guests (SevenRooms), check avg $32. Continuous flow Tuesday keeping floor and bar bumping; many first-timers; guests asked for the kitchen. Short waitlist accommodated easily. Busiest 6:30-7:30. Top sellers: Native Lion, Shinebox, Long Time Caller. Two no-shows (2 at 7:40pm, 2 at 11pm), not charged. Glassware breakage: 1 SOF, 1 tulip. Menu count 18/18.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 9/29 (MOD/Chef Julian, Saleh; nice and warm).** Net sales $4,725 vs target $4,500 (+5.0%). Food $1,051. All Marquee (Standing Room $0). Comps $65. 111 guests, check avg $42.57. Slow start, then a reservation of 8 turned into a party of 20 and was moved to the 20s section. Several birthdays, lots of new faces, bar busy, one-man kitchen just as busy. Skeleton crew (1 server, 1 host). Maintenance: water day 5-6, CO2 still down. 86: micro shiso. Favorite moment: all hands on deck including the manager.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 9/29 (MOD Marcus).** Total net sales incl. events $5,556.54 vs target $2,279 (+143.8%). Marquee bar sales $6,114.51 (reported total); food $601. Comps $61 (employee $12, gift $20, DNL $17). 129 guests (103 walk-ins, 26 reservations); check avg $43.07 (net/guests; form reported GCA $37.42, CA $81.16). First pop 5:30, took off after 8 and stayed full; driven by a medical convention and a nearby convention party. Last call 11:30, room empty ~12:30. Bar training for Teleia (barback) and Owen (2nd night). Maintenance: leak in carbonation/water filtration system, shut off overnight; curtains. Voided previous day's event ticket. Kitchen: solid Tuesday.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 9/29 (AM Sam/Shannon; PM Justin/Drew; sunny, warm).** Net sales $3,678 vs target $4,270 (-13.9%). Food $1,408. Municipal AM $890, PM $2,736; Sun Club $51; Hot Eye $0. Comps $133.70. 121 guests (45 AM + 76 PM OpenTable), check avg $30.40. Slower Tuesday; two large food tours midday; local law firm outing 5-7pm; evening pop at 7:30 mostly drinkers; no guests after 10:30. Sun Club: one morning sale, visitors 2-3pm. Maintenance: leak in front desk office. Kitchen: slow, no lows or 86s.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Tuesday 9/29 (MOD Curtis; overcast, on/off rain).** Net sales $8,645 vs target $8,000 (+8.1%). Food $1,192. Comps $509.97 (5.6%; 1 full comp for influencers, DNLs high). 196 guests, check avg $41.97. Busy start, steady all night, heavy industry crowd; noticeable sales dip after 9:30. New water offerings slowed service. Cass sent home sick (Malachi covering tomorrow). Kitchen: S'fian solo. Maintenance: freezer still down (Orcas sent wrong part by Krowne). 86: Uwajima Gimlet, Violet Carpenter, tartare — heavy prep needed.
